spec_match.rationale: Observes the spec'd lifecycle (null before establishment) with a real construction and immediate read, and teaches the why-no-SameObject point straight from Chromium's own IDL comment, which the page links.

interactive.rationale: One button runs the four real lifecycle steps with per-step results; the unreachable endpoint guarantees the null phase is observable.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the lifecycle rule made observable with cleanup; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers attribute-absent engines (undefined throughout, honestly labelled), a hypothetical contract violation (non-null early read flags as report-worthy), and teardown.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5194104408506368; the page links the IDL comment directly.

conformance.rationale: The suite's null-before-establishment assertion is step 2 verbatim.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: constructed, read undefined (attribute absent — honest pre-153 state), outcome and close steps green; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: wth-null-before-ready and wth-lifecycle-ran asserts record the readings.

design_system.rationale: Step results emerald/rose on paper (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Steps are labelled text rows; status aria-live; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Step rows wrap; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Observe the null→Headers transition on a supporting engine
openQuestions.detail: With the flag on, step 2 should read null ✓ and (via the lab page against a reachable endpoint) the post-ready read should return a Headers object distinct from the null phase.

guidanceConsulted.query: step progress list live results screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Represent lifecycle sequences as labelled text steps.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Four step rows with textual results plus an aria-live summary.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Flex-wrap step rows with min-width 0 labels.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): all four lifecycle steps ran for real on Chromium 141 with the honest attribute-absent readings; the guaranteed-null design (unreachable endpoint) means the contract phase is observable the moment an engine ships the attribute.
